title: Uniform Inference and Certified Capacity at a Reflexive Stability Boundary
abstract: arXiv:2609.02535v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper develops uniform inference and certified capacity decisions for an estimated financial stability boundary. Conditional risk, temporary cross-impact, and effective risk-bearing capacity are jointly estimated from dependent observations. Conventional pointwise inference is reliable at a separated simple spectral root but can fail near semisimple or defective collisions. Projecting a valid joint confidence region for the underlying inputs avoids this local approximation and yields a three-way regime decision with abstention and a one-sided capacity bound. A verified two-dimensional implementation keeps numerical error from creating a resolved sign. Structural simulations recover the predicted tradeoff between coverage and resolution, while observed-risk stresses distinguish statistical abstention from an insufficient computational budget. The financial conclusions remain conditional on the identification of cross-impact, the norm

translated_title: 反身性稳定边界处的一致推断与认证容量
translated_abstract: 本文针对估计得到的金融稳定边界，发展了统一推断与认证容量决策方法。条件风险、暂时性交叉影响和有效风险承载能力由相依观测数据联合估计得出。传统的逐点推断在分离的单谱根处是可靠的，但在半单根或亏损根碰撞附近可能失效。通过对底层输入的有效联合置信区域进行投影，可以避免这种局部近似，并产生带弃权选项的三方机制决策以及单侧容量界。经过验证的二维实现确保数值误差不会造成符号被错误判定。结构性模拟再现了理论预测的覆盖率与分辨率之间的权衡，而观测风险压力测试则将统计性弃权与计算预算不足区分开来。金融层面的结论仍取决于交叉影响的识别方式与范数的选取。
tldr: 本文提出在金融稳定边界处通过投影联合置信区域进行一致推断，克服了传统逐点推断在谱根碰撞附近失效的问题，实现了带弃权选项的三方机制决策与单侧容量认证界。
en_tdlr: This paper develops uniform inference at a reflexive financial stability boundary by projecting valid joint confidence regions to avoid the failure of pointwise inference near spectral collisions, yielding a three-way regime decision with abstention and a one-sided certified capacity bound.
